== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Ulrok Crag-Strider is a [[Ghost-Blade]] competitor who participated in a [[tournament]] where he was identified as a likely opponent for [[Mercy]]. Although he presents himself as an animalistic and brutish fighter—using snarling behaviors, a rough saber, and charging like a bull to gain psychological advantages—this persona is a facade. In his home country, he was actually a celebrated philosopher and poet recognized for his writings regarding the soul. During combat, he utilizes [[Forger techniques]] by channeling gray-[[green madra]] into his weapon to create ghostly echoes and can manipulate [[sword]] and Death aura{{!}}death aura within the air.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Ulrok Crag-Strider is a renowned philosopher and poet within his native land. He participates in the [[tournament]] as a [[Ghost-Blade]] competitor and fights as an [[Uncrowned King]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|He utilizes a saber in combat. His repertoire includes a [[Forger technique]] that employs spiraling gray-[[green madra]].}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|A famous poet and philosopher in his homeland, Ulrok Crag-Strider traveled to compete as a [[Ghost-Blade]] in the [[tournament]]. He fought as an [[Uncrowned King]], wielding a saber during his matches. In combat, he utilized a [[Forger technique]] characterized by the use of spiraling gray-[[green madra]].}}
